metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a three-electrode CGX forehead patch alongside standard 33-channel polysomnography (not included in this release). Sleep stages were manually scored in 30-second epochs (Wake, REM, N1, N2, N3, unknown/movement) to produce a visual hypnogram, and spectral scoring was derived from the forehead patch channels per epoch. Patch data were time-aligned to the cap-based polysomnography recordings using start-time metadata, with occasional discrepancies of a few seconds; hypnograms were trimmed as needed to match patch data length. Two subjects (113, 121) were excluded due to inadequate or unavailable patch data.
